title: New here, wanted to share some vivid and/or recurring locations I’ve seen in dreams.
content: Gently let me know if this isn’t the type of content that should be on this sub. I looked around and it feels appropriate. Anyway… 1) A boxy structure made of mossy stone in a park. I went inside and it even had makeshift beds made of stone. 2) A cylindrical green structure on a hill with ramps that lead to different mini golf courses. 3) A long bridge, reminds me of the Golden Gate. In my dream it was enveloped in fog so thick that I couldn’t see anything around me. I was a passenger in a car. The driver was a woman that I’d never seen before but felt like like I knew VERY well. She wouldn’t speak to me. I put my head in her lap and started bawling before waking up. 4) A zoo? Amusement park? I was at a gate where you’d buy tickets to get in. There was a crowd. Another woman struck up a conversation with me. As she was talking I had this overwhelming feeling of “IT’S YOU!” (From the bridge). She looked different but it was like she was “in disguise” Or something. Her chipper demeanor instantly changed to panic and she ran off. 5) Disney World…kinda. I think this is just my own creation as it usually involves trying to wrangle my family to be places where/when they should be while on vacation. This is my most recurrent of settings though.
